newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme gets cartilage approval letter.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme gets cartilage approval letter.

text.p: Genzyme Tissue Repair said Friday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has informed it that its biologics license application for its Carticel autologous cultured chondrocytes will be approved once the company clarifies certain details and formally agrees to specific post-approval requirements.
Carticel employs a proprietary process to grow autologous, or a patient's own, cartilage cells for implantation to correct certain types of knee cartilage damage.
The company said it expects to be able to complete all of the requirements outlined in the approvable letter by late July or early August.
